messages:
anya: Proposal summary: 'sidecar-decant' 1 remove enrichment from the hot proxy by moving enrichment to a per-pop sidecar pool. Keep routing minimal in the hotpath.

meera: Why 'decant' vs previous splits?

anya: Decant emphasizes staged draining: traffic -> routing shim -> sidecar async enrichers. Benefit: reduce tail latency and make cache ownership explicit.

sam: High-level phases?

anya: Phase 0: mirror-only sidecar - deploy sidecars that receive mirrored requests for telemetry. Phase 1: routing shim (read-only) handles 10% opt-in. Phase 2: sidecar handles enrichment writes for opt-in tenants (dual-write to old enrichment for safety). Phase 3: widen, then decommission old enrichment.

jess: Important: sidecars will have different batching semantics. Need tests for tokenization and deterministic ordering.

meera: KV concerns: prefix collisions and TTL semantics. We should version prefixes and include a migration marker. I'll own a small 'prefix-checker' job.

sam: Ops note: flags will be per-tenant+per-pop. Example: {"sidecar.enabled":false, "sidecar.canary_tenants":["alpha"]} (stringified in rollout service).

mikel: SRE: canary plan + rollback thresholds. Auto-rollback if p99 > baseline+20% or error-rate >0.3% sustained 3m. Also a divergence detector: if reconciliation finds >0.05% mismatched keys in 30m, flip back cohort. I'll draft runbook.

anya: Trace tagging: add span attr "decant.phase" and "decant.sidecar_id" so we can triage regressions.

jess: Tests: replay harness against real traces (meera + jess). We'll assert idempotency and ordering.

meera: Migration approach for cache: write-through to new sidecar shard during dual-write; read from old cache until reconciliation passes. Conflict resolution = tombstone-aware last-write-wins, but we'll surface anomalies to the migration dashboard.

sam: Implementation: keep routing shim tiny, no enrichment logic until phase 2. Sidecars expose a compact HTTP/gRPC API for enrich requests and accept a batching window param.

anya: Rollout plan: opt-in tenants only for first 2 weeks, expand by cohort. Keep cost signals - if per-tenant cost rises >1.2x, auto-fallback that tenant.

mikel: I'll add synthetic scenarios to the canary dashboard to catch batching regressions that increase GPU CPU cycles.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pipeline scheduled: sidecar-decant/canary/1768129999. Logs: https://ci.internal/sidecar-decant/canary/1768129999

anya: Action items: Sam - routing shim PR (mirror mode), Meera - prefix-checker + replay harness, Jess - integration tests for ordering, Mikel - runbook + dashboards. I'll open the RFC follow-up doc with checklists and owners.

meera: One more: add an invariant check in reconciliation to detect out-of-order enrichment results; fail the migration if >0.01% occur.
